claims.report_quote: - `maxBodyBytes` and `maxEntries` come only from the overlay (`shipping.json`). If the overlay omits them, `Buffer.byteLength(text) > undefined` is false and the body is unbounded (`wire.mjs:5`). `decodeEntries` would also reject every request, because `value.length > undefined` is false and so it would accept unlimited entries.
claims.reason: Shipping supplies the cap. Undefined limit disables the comparison only in an administrator-selected changed profile.

claims.report_quote: - `wire.mjs:4` does `text += chunk`, which can corrupt multibyte characters split across chunks. This is a correctness problem.
claims.reason: Chunkwise Buffer coercion can corrupt UTF-8 sequences split across chunks; it is a functional observation.
